presets.title: Normal Universe
presets.name: normal
presets.description: Gravity pulls down and objects bounce.

presets.title: Low Gravity
presets.name: lowGravity
presets.description: Gravity is one tenth as strong.

presets.title: Zero Gravity
presets.name: zeroGravity
presets.description: Nothing pulls. Objects drift and bounce.

presets.title: Strong Gravity
presets.name: strongGravity
presets.description: Gravity is five times as strong.

presets.title: Upside Down
presets.name: upsideDown
presets.description: Gravity pulls up.

presets.title: Outward Gravity
presets.name: outwardGravity
presets.description: Everything is pushed away from the centre of space.

presets.title: Cosmos
presets.name: cosmos
presets.description: Objects attract each other. Space has no favoured direction.

presets.title: Charged Particles
presets.name: charged
presets.description: Like charges repel in a magnetic field.

presets.title: No Third Law
presets.name: noThirdLaw
presets.description: Objects are pulled, but nothing pulls back. Momentum breaks.

presets.title: Looping Space
presets.name: torus
presets.description: Leave one side and come back on the other.

presets.title: Taxicab Space
presets.name: taxicab
presets.description: Force depends on distance measured along the axes.

presets.title: Sticky Universe
presets.name: merging
presets.description: Objects that touch join into one.

presets.title: Fertile Universe
presets.name: spawning
presets.description: Objects that touch create a new object.

presets.title: Decaying Mass
presets.name: decay
presets.description: Every object slowly loses mass.

presets.title: Anti-Friction
presets.name: antiFriction
presets.description: Moving objects speed up on their own, up to the limit.

presets.title: Slow Time Zone
presets.name: slowTime
presets.description: Time runs at one fifth speed in the blue centre region.

presets.title: Portal Universe
presets.name: portals
presets.description: A portal at the bottom sends objects to the top, turned.

presets.title: Heavier When Faster
presets.name: heavyWhenFast
presets.description: An object's mass grows with its speed.

presets.title: Chaotic Universe
presets.name: chaotic
presets.description: Gravity flips every 50 steps, with negative drag.

presets.title: Protected Universe
presets.name: protected
presets.description: A speed limiter runs after every step, on top of normal laws.
